placement.note: Same placement server/chains/apex_core.py uses before slicing.

method: Placement matches ApexCore (Z rotation 270 deg, Y and Z mins shifted to 0, X centered at 140). Plantar outline = convex hull of mesh vertices with Z <= 0.50 mm (belt side) plus the hull of the full footprint for the length. Axis = first principal component of the plantar vertices, flipped so s increases toward +Y (heel). Toe is the low-s end. Length = hull extent along that axis. 40% boundary is the plane normal to the axis at s_min + 0.40*L.
